chronicle.text: Zitourei tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Zitourei tied a carrier and fiber together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Miso tied a bundle they had tied and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Thasik struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Thasik tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
